name: Default studio patch
description: Right hand shapes the sound, left hand handles transport, both hands bend and widen it.

mappings.name: Filter Cutoff
mappings.comment: Raise the right hand to open the filter.

mappings.name: Resonance
mappings.comment: Move the right hand across the frame.

mappings.name: Master Volume
mappings.comment: Pinch thumb and index together to fade out.

mappings.name: Reverb Send
mappings.comment: Open the right hand for more space.

mappings.name: Pan
mappings.comment: Roll the right palm left/right. 0.5 is centre, hence the mid output.

mappings.name: Sustain Pedal
mappings.comment: Left fist holds the pedal down, opening the hand releases it.

mappings.name: Sample Trigger
mappings.comment: Point the left index finger up to fire C1 (drum pad on most kits).

mappings.name: Modulation
mappings.comment: Left peace sign switches the mod wheel in.

mappings.name: Pitch Bend
mappings.comment: Raise one hand above the other. Hands level = no bend.

mappings.name: Aftertouch (off)
mappings.comment: Example of channel pressure from hand distance to the lens. Enable to try it.
